compiled_state.title: Add behavioral test: assert exactly one llm-review job per SHA on PR builds
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: Behavioral test (under tests/scripts/ or tests/workflows/) asserts that for a typical sprint flow PR (story/<epic-id>/<story-id>-scoped → PR to main), exactly one llm-review job appears per SHA. Test uses a recorded fixture from PR #214's CI runs.

## File Impact
| File | Action | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| tests/scripts/test-single-llm-review-per-sha.sh | create | self |
| tests/fixtures/workflow-runs/pr-214-cycle-1.json | create | (fixture for test) |

## Implementation Notes
1. Create `tests/scripts/test-single-llm-review-per-sha.sh` (executable +x).
2. Test approach: Given a fixture of `gh api repos/.../actions/runs?head_sha=<sha>` recorded JSON; When the test parses the JSON and counts jobs with name='llm-review' for the SHA; Then exactly 1 must appear (not 0, not >1).
3. Recording fixture: capture from PR #214 post-rebase (commit 0a3d551bf2). Use `gh api repos/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs?head_sha=0a3d551bf2f7fe142cad723ffea8d5db9657eb54 --paginate > tests/fixtures/workflow-runs/pr-214-cycle-1.json`.
4. RED phase: the test should fail today because BOTH llm-review (ci.yml) AND Per-Story LLM Review (per-branch-review.yml) run, so the count for some metric of "LLM-review-class jobs" is 2. The test passes after Task B deletes per-branch-review.yml.
5. Update `.test-index` with a `[test_single_llm_review_per_sha]` RED marker for one of the workflow files: `.github/workflows/ci.yml:tests/scripts/test-single-llm-review-per-sha.sh [test_single_llm_review_per_sha]`.

## TDD Requirement
Test must execute, parse the fixture JSON, count llm-review-class jobs for the SHA, and assert count == 1. Test must fail on a pre-Task-B state (count == 2 because Per-Story LLM Review also runs).

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test script executable (+x) and present at tests/scripts/test-single-llm-review-per-sha.sh
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-single-llm-review-per-sha.sh
- [ ] Fixture file present at tests/fixtures/workflow-runs/pr-214-cycle-1.json
  Verify: test -f tests/fixtures/workflow-runs/pr-214-cycle-1.json
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker for the test
  Verify: grep -q '\[test_single_llm_review_per_sha\]' .test-index
- [ ] Test FAILS on current main state (pre-deletion) with descriptive error mentioning the count of llm-review-class jobs
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-single-llm-review-per-sha.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]
